cases.title: Workbook monthly values vs annual summaries

cases.source: Monthly Summary 2026 F3:F14 sums to 2426123; F16 "ANNUAL TOTAL" 2425123; Quarterly Summary G7 2427123

answer.question: Do the workbook's monthly values and annual summaries agree?
answer.answer: No. The workbook’s monthly values and annual summaries do not fully agree. In the Monthly Summary, the summed monthly values disagree with the stated annual totals for grid supply, total consumption, grid cost, and net cost, while solar, wind, total renewable, and renewable savings agree [E1][E2]. The Quarterly Summary annual row agrees with its own quarterly rows, but it conflicts with the Monthly Summary annual row and the Source-wise Annual Analysis for several annual totals, including grid, solar, total renewable, total consumption, grid cost, and savings [E2][E3][E4].

cases.title: Complaint resolution deadline absent from policy
cases.question: Does the quality policy specify a deadline for resolving customer complaints?
cases.source: quality_policy_nestle.pdf, all pages; no time limit for complaints is stated

answer.question: Does the quality policy specify a deadline for resolving customer complaints?
answer.answer: No. The Nestlé Food Safety and Quality Policy provided does not specify any deadline for resolving customer complaints. It sets broad commitments on food safety, compliance, product quality, end-to-end quality, and employee responsibility, but the provided policy text contains no customer-complaint resolution timeframe [E1][E2].

answer.answer: For FY 2025-26, the supported water consumption for Coca-Cola Beverages India Pvt. Ltd. is 2321 Cubic Meters, based only on the December 2025 bill [E1].
